stories.title: It Runs in the Family
stories.detail: The Merretts are well represented, with Charles and Helen both finding the short grass more often than not.

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome to Wagga Wagga Country Club, Robert Hartwig - great to have Coolangatta & Tweed Heads Golf C with us today. Enjoy your round.

stories.title: Building Something

stories.title: The Golf Tax
stories.detail: One good hole then one bad on holes 2 & 3 - the course charges a fee for everything

stories.title: Hero to Zero
stories.detail: 3-pointer then a wipe on holes 2 & 3 - feast then famine
